description: Battle event handler pointer table discovered at ROM offset 0x53E6D8. 14 entries of u32 pointers to Thumb event handler code.

fields.name: handler_ptr
fields.description: Pointer to Thumb event handler code

notes: Battle event handler pointer table with 14 entries. All entries point to Thumb code (PUSH instructions starting with 0xB5). Only 3 unique handlers are used: 0x07EFFD (used 7 times), 0x07F065 (used 5 times), and 0x07F149 (used 2 times). The handlers alternate in a pattern similar to the map event handler table. Located in the 0x53Exxx region between the story tables and the map headers.
verification_method: Static analysis - found 14 consecutive u32 pointers at 0x53E6D8, all pointing to valid ROM addresses with Thumb PUSH instructions.
discovered_by: Examining region 0x53E000-0x53F000 between story tables and map headers
